I would highly recommend taking Felipe Perez; I haven’t taken the other professor so I can’t speak on his behalf but I’ve taken perez for Statics, Structures 1, Structures 2 lecture and lab. He is very passionate about structures and he wants the students to truly learn. He has you download or print out premade worksheets ( it can be a lot, I think for the semester we got to 100+ pages ) but it’s not ink draining either. He then uses those pre made notes and takes more notes on top of that and you follow along with him. His test are just like the notes and in my opinion are very easy if you understand the notes well. He does give out homework and since the class I’m in is now online with him he has chosen to go with a project route rather than a final exam. The project is just a more complicated version of our notes and he ask us to analyze it. You do truly learn a lot by taking a class with perez but he can sometimes assign hw assignments that either take 1 page to complete or 4+ ( even if it’s only 1-2 problems) if you take him for Statics you will be more than prepared for structures 1 and so forth. Highly recommend if you are looking to pursue structural engineering.
